terms: A sitter visits on the dates you choose and stays about 30 minutes.
Add watering notes for each plant in the app before your trip.
Sitters look after plants only, not pets, mail or other chores.
After each visit, your sitter posts a photo update in the app.
You can cancel for free up to 24 hours before the first visit.

Entry details you share are deleted after the last visit.
These terms take effect on the day you agree to them.

scroll.title: Monstera care guide
scroll.description: Follow these steps to help your new plant settle in.

steps.light: Place it in bright, indirect light, a few steps back from a sunny window.
steps.rotate: Turn the pot a quarter turn each week so it grows evenly.
steps.water: Water when the top 2–3 cm of soil is dry, until water drains from the bottom.
steps.saucer: Empty the saucer after watering so the roots don't sit in water.
steps.leaves: Wipe the leaves with a damp cloth every two weeks.
steps.food: Give it plant food once a month from spring to early autumn.
steps.winter: Keep it away from cold drafts and heaters in winter.
steps.pets: Keep it out of reach of cats and dogs, as the leaves can upset their stomachs.
